item.text: {"search_note":"I searched for 2024 Egypt/Sisi material using multiple formulations around `nuclear threat`, `nuclear use`, `brinkmanship`, and `apocalyptic` language, plus `El-Dabaa` and `peaceful nuclear` framing. I did not find credible 2024 evidence that Sisi used nuclear threats, normalized nuclear weapons use, or spoke in reckless nuclear terms. The available 2024 record is overwhelmingly about civilian nuclear power and energy security, not coercive nuclear signaling. So the evidence base for `1B.2` is one-sided toward responsible rhetoric, with no reliable contrary example located in this search pass.","evidence":[{"title":"President El-Sisi Pleased with Historic Moment of Pouring 1st Concrete into El-Dabaa Power Unit 4","publisher":"Presidency of the Republic of Egypt","date":"2024-01-23","url":"https://www.presidency.eg/en/%D9%82%D8%B3%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1/%D8%A3%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%B1%D8%A6%D8%A7%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%A9/news2312024-1/","summary":"Sisi described El-Dabaa as a “peaceful nuclear plant” and framed it as a national development milestone.
